thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=embed-queue-eu (pd_incident: PD-89231). Symptoms: 5xx surge + queue backlog. Auto-escalation to oncall. link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/PD-89231

pagerbot: page fired -> severity: high, affected: embeddings-worker-eu, metric: requests_5xx_rate (x12 baseline), region: eu-west-1. Auto-retry suppressed.

Diana: acked. I'm the current oncall, looking now. What is the customer impact?

Omar: seeing spike in logs too, sample: ``ERROR embedder: push failed: rpc: deadline exceeded (latency 2.8s)``. Multiple clients reporting degraded embeddings.

Diana: initial check: autoscaler didn't add nodes, pods in CrashLoopBackOff for embedder-v2. Rolling restart might help. I'm going to try a quick restart of failing pods.

Kevin: I can take ownership of mitigation if Diana needs to step out in ~20m.

Diana: handing to Kevin if you want it. Customer-impact: several enterprise tenants are getting 500s for embed endpoints, some background jobs are queuing up. I'll add the list in a sec. :warning:

Sylvia: tagging infra slack: we may need to scale dedicated pool. rdctl reports pool "embeddings-eu-reserved" at 92% GPU util and queue depth 6k.

Kevin: taking ownership — will post actions and ETA. Step 1: restart embedder pods to clear bad state. Step 2: temporarily route traffic to embeddings-us-east as failover. Step 3: scale pool if routing insufficient.

Kevin: running command: ``rdctl pods restart --selector app=embedder,env=prod-eu``

incidentbot: action log: restart job queued by Kevin (job id 98321).

Diana: after restart one embedder instance came back but 2 still failing, logs show out-of-memory OOMKilled on startup. Might be a regression from yesterday's deploy. Rolling back to v2.3.1 could be safer.

Omar: confirm: v2.4.0 was pushed yesterday; memory request lowered. Likely cause.

Kevin: I'm triggering a controlled rollback to v2.3.1 on EU pool now. Command: ``rdctl deploy rollback --service embedder --to v2.3.1 --region eu-west-1``

pagerbot: escalation: if rollback does not reduce 5xx within 5m, will escalate to SRE lead. Next escalation window 5m.

Diana: tagging customers team for comms. cc @support-leads. Draft note: "We are investigating elevated errors for embeddings in EU; temporary failover and rollback in progress. Expect improved behavior within 10-15 minutes."

Sylvia: started temporary traffic reroute: ``rdctl route set --service embeddings --from eu-west-1 --to us-east-1 --weight 30%`` to reduce pressure.

Kevin: rollback completed (job 98322). Observability: 5xx rate dropping from x12 -> x3 in 6m, latency back to ~120ms for restarted pods. Queue depth decreasing.

incidentbot: PD-89231 update: owner=kevin, status=mitigated (partial), notified: support, infra, SRE.

Diana: thanks Kevin. I'll stay on until 1hr post-mitigation and then close the PD if stable.

Omar: monitoring looks good. Will follow up with a post-incident note if things stay stable. :thumbsup:

pagerbot: PD-89231 will auto-close if no further alerts in 30m.

Kevin: leaving a checklist for postmortem: confirm root cause (memory request regression), revert memory config in CI, create alert for deploy-induced memory changes, add an autoscaler safety cap.

Diana: agreed. I'll schedule the postmortem and add assignees. Thanks everyone.
